trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. No multiplayer or DLC is needed. PowerPyx rates the whole road at about 200 hours and difficulty 4 out of 10.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops after the first main mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when Chapter 1 ends, as the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, begins.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when Chapter 2 ends, as the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, begins.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops after the final mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, gold. It pops after the final mission of the game, Starting From Zero, at the end of Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 4 mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The 100% checklist unlocks after the story under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on it is missable. It is closer to 60% true completion: most collectibles are only partly required, and you need 70 of 80 challenges. PowerPyx calls it the hardest trophy in the game.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Mix categories; under-the-bridge flights are the quickest. The 100% checklist wants 300. Track progress under Progress, Activities, Stunts.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The tracker counts 9 activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race or drone race, and performing a stunt. Do one of each; most come naturally from the story and other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. PowerPyx has a separate guide mapping every range and gold medal.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations, 42 drone races in total. PowerPyx maps every location.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races from the 40 unique race locations PowerPyx lists. Any race type counts.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing spot west of Key Lento, marked with a purple map icon. Go there and beat him in the fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one of the 4 arcade games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind at the TV in your home, or Bang For Your Buck at arcade machines around the world. Finish all levels once; you do not need every challenge.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia-only questline. In Chapter 3 Andy calls and texts her address in Belville. Finish her 5 quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All still available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline starts in Chapter 1 after the mission Island Dreams. He calls, then marks himself with a green KR icon in Key Lento. Dive for his treasures at 7 shipwrecks, using the metal detector on the ocean floor, and bring them back. He goes quiet in later chapters but returns in Chapter 2-3, so nothing is missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, marked at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Finish his 5 quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All still available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Only certain stranger strands count: Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries), plus more still being confirmed. Questlines like Moses, Tyrone, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count. All remain available after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wishlist opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso and unlock the Key Cloner. Deliver the 16 sports cars he wants; scan cars with the WAiNK app to check the list, and look for them around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach. Track it under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only questline. After the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City. Destroy the labs in Take Out Kitty Litter, then Tyrone gives you Spin On This. Still available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at 18 spots across 10 locations; doing a spot with both Jason and Lucia counts twice. POSSIBLY MISSABLE: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation. It raises the counter but is not marked as a spot, and PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed whether it is required. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18, and the last spot needs both characters together, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Jason-only questline. After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Bret Vogel texts Jason and marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. He gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle and marks hunting spots; hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. Track the 15 Target Decks under Map, Activities; all 15 are needed for 100%.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. PowerPyx maps all 18 set locations.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots by holding Up then R1: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher tags. Any 100 count; there are more than 100 in the world.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way. Track them under Progress, Challenges, and pick the easiest ones you have left.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Needs both characters together, unlocked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Call your partner, build a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone. Easiest escape: the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and helicopters struggle to follow. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is, since bank vaults trigger 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner while keeping a wanted level; stay in the flashing red-blue zone, not the red heat zone. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City work well: rob a few items in each, break the safe with sticky bombs, and the trophy pops about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop. Available after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app: hold Up to open it, look at a vehicle, hold R1 to scan. You do not need to drive them. The game has 557 vehicles at launch; the 100% checklist needs 200 base models scanned, so this comes naturally.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus (L3+R3 while aiming) and take down 5 enemies in one use. Buff focus first with food, drinks or Adrenaline, wear body armor, and line up 5 enemies at a gang operation with an assault rifle like the Duke 556. It does not work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus levels up through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so it gets easier late in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA, not the ones on the airfield. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, use the stairs by the boarding bridge, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. Fly 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport for it to pop.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base; drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, get in and shoot enemies until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to unlock the Snap Gun and jewelry store robberies. Break into a jewelry store through the back door with the Snap Gun; do not kick the door, that triggers the alarm. In the back room, find the safe code note, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot. It pops shortly after you leave.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is (Wait at the Cafe) to unlock bank vault robberies; the first one is part of the mission. Then pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark security vans, tail one to a bank, slip in while the vault is open and rob it with your partner, then escape the 4-star wanted level on a fast motorcycle. Any 5 of the 8 large bank jobs count; 100% needs all 8, and each pays up to $205,000.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the red heat radius. It pops automatically in That's Where The Money Is, since robbing the bank vault counts. Earlier method: block an armored truck near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape. Sticky bombs come from the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the map by flying a plane over every black-fog area until all 52 areas of Leonida are visible. A plane is the fastest way; PowerPyx has an unfogging route guide.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs; 39 operations exist in total and 100% needs all 39. They show as yellow icons when you get near them, and you can track each gang under Progress, Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and buy an Apple Martini, then drink it standing next to the bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: After unlocking the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City, hack it, and drive it straight through the showroom window. Only this blue Banshee counts, a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. It pops a moment after you drive away.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a gang operation marked during the Chapter 2 mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, and steal all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (code 0300 or sticky bombs). It pops after you escape the police; the items do not all need to be taken in one visit.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time; check under Touchpad, Jason and Lucia, Strength. Available after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Buy a gym membership and always train together: call your partner along, and while one works out the other trains too. Home workouts unlock after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile; the trophy list shows the count. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, and watch for the demon-face icon. Stealthy objectives and clean escapes build Professional; limb shots build Hardened; killing builds Violent and Psycho. It comes passively; if you are short at the end, it can be farmed quickly.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: In the prologue Lucia robs a Payday Loans store. After the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) unlocks Payday Loans robberies and the Dye Pack Jammer, return alone as Lucia to the Payday Loans in Little Cuba, rob the 3 cash drawers, and escape on foot, not in a vehicle, until it pops.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg: at night after 2AM, go alone to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County. If a blinking car is there, follow the path into the woods to the UFO's bright blue light, approach it, talk to the woman it drops and help her back to her car. The car spawn is slightly random; drive away and return if it is not there.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: On any bike, kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Crowded spots like Vice City or Ocean Beach work best.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: After Credit Check in Chapter 3 unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer, launder $250,000 of marked bills through a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. It counts across all robberies; bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest: the game has 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 67 clothing stores, 11 tattoo studios and more.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages, $160,000 total, through the Vice City Real Estate phone app, unlocked after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. The 4 story garages do not count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, unlocked after the Chapter 2 mission Moses. Buy enough garages first (see Little Boxes) for parking spots, then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray and Register; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Cheap low-end cars and bikes keep the cost down.
